draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and yes — this is a known issue. When a task has more than one assignee, the CSV export can omit the "Assignee" column for that task entirely. Our team is aware of it and a fix is expected in an upcoming release.

In the meantime, the recommended workaround is to use the JSON export instead, which correctly includes all assignees for multi-assignee tasks.

Sorry for the inconvenience this has caused, and thank you for flagging it. Let us know if you run into anything else.

Best,
Loopwise Support
